# Unit app-2: notes

Branch `app-2` (base origin/main `d03febd`, runtime merged). Resource locks held by the unit: `routing`, `migrations`. Part 2a needed no migration.

## Decisions (B-24xx, to be copied into DECISIONS.md at merge)

| ID | Date | Decision | Reason |
|----|------|----------|--------|
| B-2400 | 2026-11-16 | `app.py` mounts `shifde.runtime.api.router` with the same `require_auth` guard as every other `/api/v1` router, sets `app.state.governance = TokenBudgetHooks()` (the P5 alias of `PolicyBudgetHooks`, as SETH 3ba0e06 `app.py:97`) and registers the feature keys `operate` and `pipelines` (SETH `app.py:130-132`). SETH `test_p2_iam.py::test_session_advertises_exactly_the_implemented_features` is ported unchanged to `tests/app/test_iam.py` (closes the APP-2 half of B-2252). The route-table test (`tests/app/test_routes.py`) now expects SETH minus branding and the three per-organization group writes, plus `/healthz` and the unified-only routes; it asserts the 16 runtime routes and `platform/status` are mounted. | Brief APP-2 part 2a items 1, 3. |
| B-2401 | 2026-11-16 | `GET /api/v1/platform/status` (SETH `tenancy/api.py:144`, `service.platform_status`, `_worker_status`, `PlatformStatusOut` and parts) lives in tenancy as in SETH; the `workers` SQL is `tenancy.repository.worker_heartbeats` (installation-level table, no client column, `USING (true)`). Change from SETH (SEC Minor-2): platform administrators only, through `tenancy.service._require_platform_admin` (principal flag, person on an unpinned session, PDP `platform:admin`): anyone else gets 403. Worker health window (J m2): healthy = a running worker beat within `max(3 x worker_lease_seconds, 15)` s, stale = workers known but none recent (stopped rows never count), not_running = none. `auth.oidc_providers` stays SETH's literal 0 (the installation overview reports the IdPs; counting them here is left). Tests: `tests/app/test_tenancy_api.py::test_platform_status` (SETH assertions unchanged, caller the platform administrator), `::test_platform_status_refuses_everyone_but_the_platform_administrator` (viewer of A, administrator of A, administrator of B: 403 with no status body; anonymous 401), `::test_platform_status_worker_health_window`. Route cross-client case: `tests/tenancy/test_cross_client.py::test_platform_status_answers_the_platform_administrator_and_no_client` (owner and viewer of A, owner of B, a person in both, that person pinned to B: 403; the platform administrator: 200), listed in `ROUTE_TESTS`. | Brief item 2; carry_forward runtime row (B-1013, B-1020, B-2290). |
| B-2402 | 2026-11-16 | `tests/runtime/routes.py::runtime_client(mounted=True)` serves the runtime routes from `create_app` (pipeline schedules on). `tests/runtime/test_routes_cross_client.py` runs its `client` fixture over the minimal app and over the mounted app, so every cross-client case (B's ids like unknown ids, B's slug unknown, lists and filters, ids inside A's bodies, the run started through the route) runs on both. New `test_the_mounted_app_serves_exactly_the_covered_runtime_routes`: the runtime routes in the mounted OpenAPI (matched to the router by operation id) equal the covered set, and each answers 401 without a session. FastAPI 0.162 includes routers lazily (`app.routes` holds `_IncludedRouter`), so the check reads the OpenAPI document, not `app.routes`. | Brief item 1. |
| B-2403 | 2026-11-16 | Governance and ontology runtime guards: already removed on main by the runtime unit (no `to_regclass`/`to_regprocedure`/`_has_runs_table` in `governance` or `ontology`; `shifde_ops_stats` is in `runtime_0001`); review 2 G2 is covered by `tests/ontology/test_run_tie.py` (run of A, of B, of another artifact on `query`, `get_object`, `action_inputs`) and `tests/ontology/test_service.py`. The last guard of this kind, `installation.service._table_exists` (B-1105, `workers` and `egress_policies`), is removed: both tables exist (`runtime_0001`, `connections_0001`). | Brief item 4. |
| B-2404 | 2026-11-16 | `shifde-worker` (`shifde.runtime.worker:run`) is unchanged; `uv run shifde-worker --help` exits 0 and `tests/runtime/test_worker.py` (startup refusal, exit 3) passes. | Brief item 5. |
